name: The Andesite Age
pages: The {b}Andesite Age{/} is the early-game stage of Create: Genesis. This is where players will begin, with fewer resources and more primitive technology.{pb}Everything up until the player has access to {b}the Nether{/} would be considered part of the Andesite Age.

In this stage, gameplay will focus mostly on establishing a starter base, mining for resources, some essential farms, and a food source.{pb}In the Andesite Age, players will usually want to acquire larger quantities of {i}wood{/}, {i}iron{/}, {i}andesite{/}, and {i}copper{/} for crafting their components. {i}Kelp{/} will also become increasingly important as you advance toward the {l:progression/brass_age/}Brass Age{/l}.

In order to advance to the Brass Age, you will need to go to the Nether by building a {b}Nether portal{/} from {i}obsidian{/}. Brass Age technology will require new crafting components, so make sure you bring an {i}empty blaze burner{/} with you when you go through the portal!{pb}Items that can be {b}obtained{/} in the Andesite Age have {b}silver tooltip borders{/}.
